full_prompt_en: A square cinematic oil-style illustration shows a young woman seated on a dark wooden windowsill in a quiet room. She wears a fitted mustard dress with short puffed sleeves, a belt and a soft pleated skirt. A pale wide-brimmed hat with a dark band shades her face, while light hair gathers into a neat roll at the back. She turns to the right and looks through the large open window, her hands resting together on her lap. Her legs cross and extend diagonally toward the lower right, ending in pale turquoise shoes. A worn dark brown suitcase sits on the floor to her left, its brass clasps and handle catching a little light. Heavy green-gray curtains frame the window on both sides. Beyond them, a bright blue sky and a sunlit airfield with low pale aircraft shapes stretch into the distance. The interior wall at left is deep green and faintly patterned, making the outdoor blue feel exceptionally clear. Strong sunlight enters from the right, laying angular bright patches across her hat, shoulders, forearms, shoes and floor. Long dark shadows remain under the seat and around the luggage. The figure is modeled with smooth, realistic form, while background structures are simplified and slightly hazy. Fine brush texture and a subdued grain soften the polished illustration. Warm ochre fabric sits against cool green curtains and blue daylight, with the small turquoise shoes repeating the outdoor hue. The composition combines a close, reflective pose with a wide view beyond the window, holding the figure at the border between enclosed shade and open travel space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感油画插画呈现一位年轻女子坐在安静房间的深色木窗台上。她穿合身的芥黄色连衣裙，短泡袖、腰带和柔软褶裙可见。浅色宽檐帽带深色帽圈，为她的面孔遮阴；浅发在脑后收成整齐发卷。她向右转，望向大窗外，双手合放在膝上。双腿交叠，斜伸向右下方，脚上是一双浅青绿鞋。她左边地板上放着磨旧的深棕行李箱，黄铜扣件和把手接住一点光。厚重的灰绿窗帘从两侧框住窗户。窗外，明亮蓝天和有浅色低矮飞机形体的阳光机场延伸向远处。左侧室内墙面深绿，带隐约纹样，使室外蓝色显得格外澄净。强烈日光从右边进入，在帽子、肩膀、前臂、鞋和地面上铺出棱角分明的亮斑。长而深的阴影留在坐处下方和行李周围。人物以平顺、写实的体积塑造，背景结构则简化且略显朦胧。细微笔触肌理和低调颗粒柔化了光洁插画。暖赭衣料对着冷绿窗帘和蓝色日光，小小青绿鞋又呼应室外色调。构图把近处沉思般的姿态与窗外宽阔景色结合，让人物停在封闭阴影和开放旅途空间的边界上。
style_prompt_en: The image has a polished narrative painting surface with smooth modeled volumes, fine brush grain and slightly softened distant detail. A deep, cool interior field opens abruptly into a broad, pale blue light area. Warm mustard and ochre passages become the focal middle tone, with small turquoise accents linking near and far spaces. Strong directional sunlight lays crisp angular highlights across darker surroundings, leaving long, substantial shadows at the base. Edges are clearest around close silhouettes and hard boundaries, then become hazier in the bright distance. Fabric folds and reflective small details receive selective precision without making every area equally sharp. A diagonal rhythm crosses a mostly vertical frame of dark side masses and an open center. The viewpoint is intimate, yet the background creates a sense of travel and atmospheric depth. Color and light support a poised, reflective mood through a measured division of sheltering shade and expansive brightness.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有光洁的叙事绘画表面，体积塑造平顺，笔触颗粒细微，远方细节略被柔化。深冷色的室内色域突然打开为宽阔浅蓝亮区。暖芥黄和赭色成为中明度焦点，少量青绿强调把远近空间联系起来。方向明确的强日光在较暗环境里铺出清楚的棱角亮斑，底部留有厚重的长阴影。近处剪影与硬界面的边缘最清晰，在明亮远方则更朦胧。衣料褶皱和小型反光细节受到选择性刻画，并非每处都同样锐利。一道斜向节奏横穿由两侧深色竖向团块和开放中央构成的画面。视点亲近，背景却带来旅途感和空气纵深。色彩与光通过庇护性的阴影和广展亮光的有度分配，支撑从容、沉思的情绪。
theme_en: A traveler in a mustard dress sits on a windowsill beside a dark suitcase and looks toward a bright airfield
theme_zh: 一名穿芥黄色连衣裙的旅人坐在窗台上，身旁是深色行李箱，望向明亮机场
name: Peregrine Heathcote
